name: upload_artifact
description: Upload a generated file as a project artifact. Call this tool after creating a file: the platform injects the project/task/session context. The response contains artifactId — include every returned artifactId in RUN_SUCCEEDED and reference the same file in the chat/end event attachments. Do not upload files produced by other agents. Endpoint contract: POST {baseUrl}/api/v1/agent-tools/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}/artifacts with multipart part "file" (original file name and media type preserved). {baseUrl} is the TeamCoordinator deployment address configured when mounting this tool; {projectId} and {taskId} are substituted by the platform from the run structured input (fields projectId, taskId); headers X-AgentCore-Tool-Token (configured shared secret), X-Session-Id (structured input businessSessionId), X-Agent-Run-Id and X-Agent-Id are injected by the platform from the run context. The upload is rejected unless the agent run belongs to the supplied project task and session.

file.description: The generated file to upload (multipart part, with original file name and media type).
